title: Universally slimmable Mirror width code
hypothesis: A continuous width-dependent Givens coordinate on one shared width-elastic hidden network recovers held-out width functions more accurately and with fewer bytes than ordinary prefix-width inference, while its gain over a generic direct-coefficient width code remains to be tested.
physical_object: One shared 16-channel linear hidden network with fixed input and output maps
mirror_coordinate: Two FP32 coefficients defining an affine angle theta(q)=a+bq, applied as adjacent-channel Givens rotations before retaining the first k channels
logical_multiplicity: Width-conditioned functions at hidden widths k in {4,6,8,10,12,14,16}
controls: ordinary prefix US-Net baseline with theta=0
Mirror affine-angle coordinate fit from training widths
generic direct sine/cosine coefficient functions fit over the same shared rotated channel basis
independent full hidden-to-output matrices per requested width as a storage/quality upper control

task.teacher: Shared random U,V maps; apply a width-conditioned adjacent-pair Givens transform with theta(q)=a+bq, then retain the first k hidden channels and apply the corresponding prefix of V

development.allowed: Validate implementation and freeze any fixed solver/precision choices; do not alter widths, teacher family, or gates after opening fresh worlds.

storage.authority: actual serialized NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all per-method angle or coefficient generators
independent matrices for the upper control

success_gate: Across every fresh world and held-out width, Mirror NRMSE <=1e-4 and at least 10% lower than ordinary prefix US-Net; Mirror actual bytes <=50% of the independent-width upper; Mirror uses at least 10% fewer bytes than a generic direct coefficient code at matched quality.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any fresh quality or total-payload gate, ordinary prefix US-Net matches its quality, or the generic direct coefficient control matches its quality/bytes within 10%.
boundaries: Mechanism screen on a synthetic linear width family, not a trained US-Net or Transformer
No capacity claim from the number of tested widths
Fresh worlds test fixed teacher-family transfer only
All input and model maps are deterministic from the world seed but are serialized and charged in each method payload

amendments.reason: Separate asymmetric one-time map reconstruction from repeated forward timing
amendments.scope: Timing measurement only; preserve all A0 artifacts and replay the same worlds/inputs/settings/payloads
